name: Eleganz Interiors Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1996, Eleganz Interiors Limited is engaged in the business of Interior solutions for corporations, laboratories, airport lounges, etc.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
Eleganz Interiors Limited specializes in interior fit-out solutions for corporate and commercial spaces. Their services include corporate offices, R&D facilities, laboratories, airport lounges, flexible workspaces, and commercial retail spaces

pros: Debtor days have improved from 62.8 to 40.2 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
